meta.title: An RFQ-then-auction round next to an RFQ round on the same draft is not blocked
gaps: The complete working body for /trade/template_input is not provided, so only rfx_mode is sent.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot specify the RFQ round's bid end time, evaluator, or buyer permission settings.
The plan checks a 2xx response and event read without asserting that both RFQ and auction rounds coexist.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that adds a round to the event, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
